summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Keep SearchWoot private. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; upstream API access is documented but redistribution, storage, derivative, alert, display, and monetization rights are not established; security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is only a baseline: 34 pass, 14 fail, and 11 unknown across 59 sites. No go-live proposal is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed; all remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required. Missing evidence: current API agreement or written permission; field-level provenance and rights; storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Checklist review: compliance findings are technical signals, not legal certification; 14 sites have open banner/accept/reject/GA4 findings, with additional privacy and terms findings. Analytics is broadly available but has permission or collector errors, including GSC failures; telemetry gaps do not independently block ordinary reversible growth. Revenue evidence covers one day only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable, so site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, and causal lift remain unknown. Operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results, and security controls remain unevidenced. Keep all launch packets conditional or deferred; no site is supported for a new public launch on this evidence. Keep complicated.work parked after its compliance fail, retain deadlymaracas.com parked pending its approved assessment, and do not dispatch active-work candidates until their existing review, measurement, and release gates clear.

Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, keep external permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization, continue only the existing read-only evidence workstream, and do not close any launch-readiness task until its stated evidence is attached and reviewed.
